honest_summary: The merge preserved both mechanisms and the E8 booking, but the composition failed dynamically: sole-contact loading plus the continuous trunk table refused at tick 116. Settling is beneficial (tick 107 to 116), and the ledger is far below the vault-only 37.9 J result because E8 booking and the main entry machinery are present, but the trunk target still sweeps through a cap-saturated transition while the planted soles skid. The next membrane is a reachability-constrained vault trajectory, not another local contact membrane.
